parsed.doc_summary: Official text of G.L. c. 186, § 15B (MA): limits on upfront payments at tenancy start (first month, last month, security deposit equal to first month's rent, lock/key cost), plus security deposit handling, interest, return and penalties. Upfront-charge limits amended eff. 2025-08-01 to include agents.

unverifiable_exemptions: vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less

rules.coverage_conditions: Residential leases and tenancies in Massachusetts.
rules.effective_date_note: Original effective date of the security deposit cap not stated in the document; the August 1, 2025 amendment only added agents and fee-in-lieu authority.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.
rules.key_value: Security deposit max = first month's rent; held in separate interest-bearing MA bank account; returned within 30 days
rules.penalty: Forfeiture of right to retain deposit; damages of three times the deposit plus 5% interest, court costs and attorney's fees.
rules.quoted_span: a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2)
rules.requirement: A landlord may collect a security deposit of no more than the first month's rent. The deposit must be held in a separate interest-bearing bank account, with a receipt and a condition statement given to the tenant. It must be returned, less permitted itemized deductions, within 30 days after the tenancy ends, and the tenant is owed 5% annual interest or the bank rate if lower.
rules.title: Massachusetts security deposit law

unverifiable_exemptions: vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less

rules.coverage_conditions: Residential leases and tenancies in Massachusetts.
rules.effective_date_note: Amended text extending the limit to landlord's agents is effective 2025-08-01 per 2025, c. 9; the underlying limit on upfront payments predates this.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.
rules.key_value: Upfront charges limited to first month, last month, security deposit, and lock/key cost
rules.penalty: Forfeiture of deposit retention rights for conflicting lease terms; treble damages for certain violations.
rules.quoted_span: no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following:
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a landlord or agent can require only the first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit equal to one month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock. Nothing more may be required upfront.
rules.title: Massachusetts limits on upfront payments at tenancy start
